Gout and hyperuricemia are metabolic diseases characterized with high serum uric acid (SUA) levels that significantly impact human health. Lesinurad, a uricosuric agent, is limited to concurrent use with xanthine oxidase inhibitors (XOIs) in clinical practice due to its restricted efficacy and potential nephrotoxicity.
